class.name: LocalLinkConditions
class.brief_description: Simulated latency and packet loss for a [LocalLoopbackSession].
class.description: Used for tests. [codeblock] var conditions := LocalLinkConditions.wifi() conditions.packet_loss = 0.05 loopback_session.set_link_conditions(server, conditions) [/codeblock] The same [member seed] gives the same results every run.

method.name: create
method.description: Returns new conditions with [member seed] set to [param seed].

method.name: effective_retransmit_ms
method.description: Returns how long a lost reliable packet is delayed, from [member retransmit_ms] or computed from [member latency_ms] when it is negative.

method.name: perfect
method.description: Returns conditions with no latency or loss.

members.member: Chance that an unreliable packet arrives twice.
The most random extra delay added to an unreliable packet, in milliseconds.
Chance that a packet is lost. A lost reliable packet is delayed by [method effective_retransmit_ms] instead.
Chance that an unreliable packet arrives after the next one.
How long a lost reliable packet is delayed, in milliseconds. Negative computes it from [member latency_ms].
The random seed. The same seed gives the same results.
Chance of a pause during which nothing is delivered.
How long that pause lasts, in milliseconds.
